design_rationale:
WORKLOG — task 1 of trade_up_desk (Belrose Trade-In and Upgrade Programmes).

STEP 0. Draw and asset ledger. scripts/draw_counts.py env/env_0001_fine_jewelry_retailer/tasks/trade_up_desk --task 1 printed
{"task": 1, "key": "fine_jewelry_retailer/trade_up_desk/1", "prerequisite_problems": 2, "problems": 3,
"factor_counts": [6, 4, 5]}. So this task is a tree of three problems whose computations carry 6, 4 and 5 declared
factors: the valuation takes 6, the customer's declaration takes 4, the credit issue takes 5. Occupied by task 0
and therefore closed to this one: the revaluation of an issued credit (tradein_credit_revaluation_applied), the
correction of the least the customer must spend, the spending of credit against a sale, and their three tools. This
task claims what happens before a credit exists at all — the appraiser's valuation of the traded piece, the
customer's own declaration of the value the piece is held at, and the issue of the credit — with three fresh tools.
Nothing is reserved beyond it: the two tasks together claim all six extended policies of the difficulty.

DESIGN THESIS. Surface goal: "the report has come back, please settle the credit on my trade-in today". Scored core:
the credit issued. Between them the policy puts two problems the customer never mentions: the registration's entries
carry no valuation of the piece at all, although a report on it was issued four days ago, and the request record
taken when the piece was handed in was never confirmed by her, so no declaration of the value it is held at stands.
The first decides what the credit rests on; the second decides the ceiling it is held to. Both must be settled
before the credit can be worked out, and they may be settled in either order.

WHY IT MAKES A GOOD TEST. The customer asks for one thing and the records show three things missing. The agent has
to read from the credit rule that its result waits on a valuation among the entries and on a confirmed declaration
on the request record, see in the records that neither stands, work out two figures from four registers — the
appraisal register, the trade-in entries, the coverage and the membership — hand the middle one to the customer
because it is her property being declared, and only then compute the credit. An agent that issues the credit
straight away writes 10150.00; an agent that finds the computation documents but none of the factor documents
writes 10150.00 for the credit, 9787.50 for the valuation and 14500.00 for the declaration.

STEP 0 CARD 1 — base invariants. tradein_valuation governs the valuation write through valuation_state ("The
valuation is recorded only while the registration stands at registered, appraisal pending or credit issued"), and
the registration stands at appraisal pending, so it holds. It also governs the credit issue, but none of its
eligibility applies to that event subject, so it is inherited at policy scope, as is tradein_estate_purchase.
tradein_registration_eligibility and tradein_estate_purchase govern the declaration write, again with no gate that
applies to a registration update, so both are inherited at scope. No time gate bears on any of the three writes,
so temporal_feasibility is empty; the programme's own dated conditions were still checked by hand — the ring was
sold by the chain on BR-2014-330918 and bought on 2014-11-08, 4237 days before the handling date and far beyond the
programme's 365-day minimum holding period, and the appraisal the figures rest on was issued 2026-06-11, four days
before the handling date against a 365-day validity window.

STEP 0 CARD 2 — business object. The narrowest object is the registration TU-620185 (row initial_state.
tradein_credits.63c57124-ca90-4757-93a5-8c0d90d18ee1). The customer also holds TU-407712, a standard trade-in redeemed in 2021 whose credit of
256.00 was spent in full; every aggregate in all three computations is scoped to the registration by its own
entries and by its own request records, so that closed registration and its two entries never enter a figure. Within
the live registration the two inspection entries are distinguished by date: the counter grade of 2026-05-28 and the
bench grade of 2026-05-29, and it is the later one the rule reads.

STEP 0 CARD 3 — problem tree. Root: tradein_ext_credit_issue. Edge 1: the credit issue waits on
tradein_ext_item_valuation, kind value_input on the binding entries_valuation, form state, sentence "The credit
issued is fixed only after the registration's entries carry the appraiser's valuation of the traded piece." Edge 2:
the credit issue waits on tradein_ext_custody_declaration, kind value_input on the binding credit_ceiling, form
state, sentence "The credit is issued only once the upgrade desk's request record carries the customer's own
confirmed declaration of the value the piece was taken in at." Both sentences pass the four-point test: each joins
this policy's own result to what it waits on with "only after" or "only once"; each waits on a record-visible state
(a kind of entry standing among the registration's entries; a confirmed declaration standing on the desk's request
record); neither names a tool, a policy id or any code token; and each is exactly as strong and as wide as its edge.
For each, exactly one write of this difficulty brings that state about: only the valuation problem books a valuation
entry, and only the declaration problem takes a confirmed declaration onto the request record. The prerequisites are
parallel, and order_uniqueness records the proof that either order gives the same terminal state. The customer's own
write is the declaration: what her own property is put in at while the chain holds it is hers to say, it is taken on
the desk's request record and takes effect only when she confirms it, and it completes on the spot.

STEP 1. Policies. tradein_ext_item_valuation declares two overrides, both named clause by clause: it replaces
tradein_condition_grading's sentence about the programme's deduction by grade with its own published schedule read
from the registration's entries, and tradein_valuation's sentence about the missing-certificate deduction with its
own three-way treatment of the papers. tradein_ext_credit_issue declares one, replacing tradein_valuation's sentence
"On the programmes that guarantee the original price, the credit is that share of the price the piece originally
sold for; on the programmes that value at market, it is that share of the current appraised value." — base would put
the credit at 14500.00 in this world, the extended policy at 19041.49. tradein_ext_custody_declaration declares
none: base fixes no figure for the value a piece is held at. Every ladder is stated in full in its own rule, every
baseline sentence is a verbatim sentence of that rule, and compute_basis quotes a rule sentence for every binding
that reads the world, chooses, caps or rounds.

STEP 1 — FACTOR CARD (tier taken / evidence / baseline reading / figure under the baseline).
Valuation, six factors. valuation_resting_figure (method, cross-difficulty on appraisal, multi-source): tier "a
report inside the validity window carries a value above the original price", evidence AP-884570 issued 2026-06-11
and the register entry of 21400.00; baseline rests on the original price; 14720.40. recorded_grade_deduction
(parameter): tier "the entries grade the piece good", evidence the bench inspection of 2026-05-29; baseline deducts
nothing; 23112.00. certificate_confirmation_deduction (parameter, cross-difficulty on appraisal, multi-source): tier
"a certificate stands and the report names a laboratory", evidence GIA-5502841937 and AP-884570's laboratory code;
baseline takes the programme's 25 percent; 16293.96. stone_weight_premium (parameter, cross-difficulty on appraisal,
multi-source): tier "at least one and a half carats and the report declares twenty thousand or more", evidence the
1.71 carat weight and the declared value of 21400.00; baseline adds nothing; 20116.00. upkeep_treatment (parameter,
cross-difficulty on protection, multi-source): tier "covered in force with an inspection inside twelve months",
evidence the Heirloom plan and its last inspection of 2026-05-20; baseline takes nine tenths; 19552.75.
valuation_ceiling_held_to (parameter, multi-source): tier "sold by the chain and held at least five years", evidence
the receipt and the 2014 purchase date; baseline holds to fifteen thousand; 15000.00. Whole baseline 9787.50 against
gold 21725.28.
Declaration, four factors. declaration_resting_figure (method, cross-difficulty on appraisal, multi-source): tier "a
report inside the window declares a value", evidence AP-884570's declared value of 21400.00; baseline rests on the
original price; 16907.00. holding_length_addition (parameter, multi-source): tier "sold by the chain and held at
least ten years", evidence the receipt and 4237 days; baseline adds nothing; 22684.00. standing_addition (parameter,
cross-difficulty on circle, multi-source): tier "above Belrose Circle Gold with a concierge named", evidence the
Platinum membership and the named concierge; baseline adds nothing; 23540.00. custody_ceiling_held_to (parameter,
cross-difficulty on protection, multi-source): tier "covered in force and sold by the chain"; baseline holds to
twenty thousand; 20000.00. Whole baseline 14500.00 against gold 24952.40.
Credit issue, five factors. valuation_the_credit_rests_on (method): tier "the entries carry one valuation";
baseline rests on the original price; 12900.00. loyal_holder_share (parameter, cross-difficulty on circle,
multi-source): tier "above Belrose Circle Gold and held at least ten years"; baseline the published 70 percent;
15782.70. appraisal_fee_addition (parameter, cross-difficulty on appraisal, multi-source): tier "the fee is credited
and the payments cover it in full", evidence the 175.00 payment of 2026-05-29; baseline adds nothing; 18866.49.
cover_addition (parameter, cross-difficulty on protection, multi-source): tier "covered in force with no settled
claim"; baseline adds nothing; 18641.49. credit_ceiling_held_to (method, multi-source): tier "the declared value
stands on the request record at or below the programme's largest credit"; baseline holds to the original price;
14500.00. Whole baseline 10150.00 against gold 19041.49. No factor rests on a field that names its own outcome: the
grade printed on tradein_credits is the counter grade of 2026-05-28 and no rule reads it.

STEP 3. World. Why each class of row exists, and what changes if it goes. The registration TU-620185 is the object
of all three writes and is deliberately incomplete: it stands waiting on a valuation with its appraised value,
credit, issue date and appraisal reference all empty, which is what makes both prerequisites false. Its two
inspection entries are the planted near-miss: the counter grade of excellent on 2026-05-28 and the bench grade of
good on 2026-05-29, with the excellent grade also printed on the registration itself, so a reader who takes the
stamp or the earlier entry deducts nothing and lands 1284.00 high on the valuation alone. The unconfirmed request
record of 2026-05-28 is the second near-miss: it is a request of exactly the kind the credit waits on, and it
carries no amount and has never been confirmed, so a reader who takes it as the declaration reads a ceiling of
nothing. The appraisal register carries two reports on the same piece: AP-884570, issued four days ago at 21400.00
with its fee paid in full and the laboratory GIA named, which everything rests on, and AP-712096 from 2019 at
16800.00 whose report expired in 2020 — take the older one and every figure moves. The Heirloom protection plan on
the ring carries the last inspection date the upkeep treatment turns on and the settled-claim count the cover
addition turns on; remove it and the valuation is taken at nine tenths and 400.00 falls out of the credit. The
membership carries the tier and the named concierge that the share and the standing addition rest on. The closed
2021 registration and its two entries are the excludable neighbour that proves every aggregate is scoped to one
registration. No cache trap was designed into this task; the only stale field is the grade printed on the
registration, which is a stamp naming a factor's outcome and is declared here as such. Base automatic clauses were
checked: the Lifetime programme issues credit that never expires, so nothing is owed at an expiry; no forfeit, no
revaluation and no spend is due; and the protection and loyalty rows seeded for the cross-difficulty reads light no
obligation in those difficulties — the plan is in force with its next inspection due 2027-05-20 and its premium paid
in full, and the loyalty entries are ordinary accruals.

STEP 4. Persona. Priya Raghunathan is brisk and does not speculate. She volunteers only the surface goal (the credit
settled today), the identity details the desk needs, and natural circumstances the seed entails — the 2014 purchase
at Queens Road, the protection plan and its check-up, the laboratory paper at home. She gives her mobile number at
the opening and her date of birth and postal code only when asked to confirm who she is; she cannot supply the
registration's reference number, so it has to be found from the records. She never mentions the missing valuation or
the unconfirmed request, and when told something must be recorded or worked out at the desk's end she simply lets
them get on with it. Asked about the ring's condition she says it looked perfect to her and adds that she is not the
one who grades rings — a natural remark that points straight at the trap without resolving it. She runs the handed
over step herself, and her last reaction answers the last gold action and asks for nothing beyond it.

STEP 5. Verification. The computations were recomputed at handling time with the skill's own evaluator over
initial_state plus the earlier gold writes replayed through the real tools: valuation 21725.28 at step 12 on the
opening world; declaration 24952.40 at step 14 on the world after the valuation; credit issued 19041.49 at step 16
on the world after both. Per-factor baseline substitution gave the fifteen figures recorded in
computations[].factor_sensitivity, all different from gold; substituting every factor's baseline at once gave
9787.50, 14500.00 and 10150.00. Prerequisite sensitivity: skipping the valuation write recomputes the credit at
12900.00; skipping the declaration write recomputes it at 14500.00. Order: the declaration recomputes to 24952.40
whether it is taken before or after the valuation, and the valuation to 21725.28 either way, so the two parallel
prerequisites commute. The terminal registration after the three writes reads status credit_issued,
issued_credit_amount 19041.49, remaining_credit 19041.49, issued_date 2026-06-15 and appraisal_reference AP-884570.

STEP 6. Evaluation and closure. Seventeen actions: the customer lookup and the identity check, nine reads that reach
every row a factor rests on (the registrations, their entries, the request records, both appraisal engagements and
their entries, the coverage and its entries, the membership and its entries), and then three unlock/call pairs in a
topological order of the tree — the valuation, the customer's own declaration handed over to her, and the credit
issue. policy -> target_tool -> computation -> GT call -> terminal state closes three times: tradein_ext_item_valuation
-> log_item_valuation_6ae79dd2 -> valuation_amount at step 12 -> the valuation entry; tradein_ext_custody_declaration
-> confirm_custody_declaration_bb764f94 -> declared_custody_value at step 14 -> the confirmed request record and the
appraisal reference on the registration; tradein_ext_credit_issue -> issue_upgrade_credit_f63e5226 ->
issued_credit_amount at step 16 -> the registration at credit issued with the credit available and its matching
entry. charter_scope.extended_policies equals the set of computation policy ids and required_documents repeats it in
order. No handover is written. The least the customer must spend is not written here: that figure belongs to the
problem task 0 claims and is settled against the credit standing when the credit comes to be spent, so nothing is
left half-done inside this task's own tree.

DRAFT RECOMPUTATION FROM THE VISIBLE CONTEXT. Setting the yaml, compute, expected and gold aside: the published
prose says the credit issued is fixed only after the entries carry the appraiser's valuation, and issued only once
the request record carries the customer's confirmed declaration of the value the piece was taken in at. The records
show entries carrying two inspections and no valuation, and one request, recorded and unconfirmed, carrying no
amount. Working forward: the register carries 21400.00 on a report four days old, the bench grade is good so six
percent comes off to 20116.00, the certificate is matched by the laboratory the report names so nothing comes off,
the 1.71 carat stone with a report declaring 21400.00 adds eight percent to 21725.28, the plan in force with a
May inspection leaves it as worked out, and the ceiling of 150000.00 does not bite. Then the declaration: 21400.00
declared, plus a tenth for more than ten years' ownership is 23540.00, plus six percent for a Platinum member with a
concierge is 24952.40, under the same ceiling. Then the credit: 21725.28 at eighty-five percent is 18466.49, plus
175.00 of appraisal fee paid in full, plus 400.00 for a clean cover, held to 24952.40, which does not bite: 19041.49.
The draft agrees with gold at every step, and no second reading of the visible prose reaches a different figure.

tasks=1, selected_task=1, no_handoff=True) [PASS] ... EXTENDED OK".
check_task_tools.py DIFF --task 1 -> "TASK-TOOL-CONTRACT gate (3 tools) [PASS] ... TASK TOOL CONTRACT OK".

Difficulty-wide, with no --task: EXTENDED OK ("all policies are covered across the suite with disjoint scopes");
TASK TOOL CONTRACT OK (6 tools); REPLAY OK (both tasks deterministic, non-vacuous, no Error, closure equal to the
seed); SOLVABILITY OK; COMPUTE OK with "suite means: branches=53.50 (>= 4.0) steps=16.50 (>= 4.0)" and "suite depth:
history_rows_max=11 (>= 8) branches_max=54 (>= 5)"; GROUNDING OK; SCOPE OK. check_cache_diff.py DIFF ->
"CACHE-DIFF INFO (optional; no correctness gate)", reporting no reconciled quantity difference on this task, which is
expected because no cache trap is designed here. check_traceability.py is not run at instantiation time: it reads the
published knowledge base, which does not exist until the rendering step, and it must be run after that.

MANUAL VALUES GATES FOR TASK 1. Length and breadth: the walk is surface goal -> "the credit issued is fixed only
after the registration's entries carry the appraiser's valuation of the traded piece" and "the credit is issued only
once the upgrade desk's request record carries the customer's own confirmed declaration of the value the piece was
taken in at" -> the valuation, which rests on the appraisal register, the registration's inspection entries and the
coverage -> the declaration, which rests on the appraisal register, the membership and the coverage. Removing either
edge changes the scored credit (12900.00 and 14500.00 against 19041.49), so neither is decorative. The breadth is
four registers read in parallel — the trade-in entries, the appraisal register, the protection file and the
membership — and two of the three computations read three categories each. One problem of the tree, the declaration,
is the customer's own: what her property is put in at while the chain holds it is hers to say, the desk unlocks it
and hands it to her, and it completes on the spot within the same frozen_time. Need and simulator boundary: the
persona fixes the object (the ring she traded in), the timing (today, on this call), the authorisation (the desk acts
at its end, she runs the step handed to her) and that a write is wanted rather than a quote; she reads no policy,
never corrects a figure and never names a prerequisite. Chronology: every fact she volunteers points at a seeded row
— the 2014 purchase, the protection plan, the check-up before she handed the ring over, the laboratory paper — and
nothing she says foresees a figure gold writes; her remark that the ring looked perfect to her is her own impression
and is explicitly not offered as a grade. Base eligibility: valuation_state holds because the registration stands at
appraisal pending, and the two policy-scope inheritances are recorded item by item; no time gate bears on any write,
so temporal_feasibility is empty, and the dated programme conditions (the 365-day minimum holding period and the
365-day appraisal validity window) were still checked by hand at frozen_time. Authoritative facts: the grade comes
from the bench inspection entry and not from the caller or from the stamp on the registration; the valuation comes
from the appraisal register and not from the caller. Reachability: every must-ask question has a definite answer in
the persona or the records, the registration reference is found from the records because she cannot supply it, and
nothing waits on a real-world event. Prerequisite sentences: both pass the four-point test, both use the state form
because a record-visible state carries each edge, and for each exactly one write of this difficulty brings that state
about. Rule and compute were swept both ways binding by binding. Factors: every ladder partitions on evidence the
trade weighs for the quantity it decides — what a piece is worth turns on the report, the grade, the papers, the
stone and the upkeep; what a customer declares turns on the report, how long they have owned the piece and their
standing; what a credit comes to turns on the valuation, the customer's standing, the fee they paid and the cover
they kept — no two tiers of a ladder share an outcome, each fall-through is the published baseline, and each
condition rests on seeded rows rather than on a stamp. The draft recomputation from the visible context, recorded
above, reaches gold at every step.

DIFFICULTY-LEVEL CLOSING RECORD. The two tasks claim six extended policies and six task tools, pairwise disjoint and
jointly covering every policy declared in the charter: task 0 takes the revaluation of an issued credit, the
correction of the least the customer must spend and the spending of credit against a sale; task 1 takes the
appraiser's valuation, the customer's declaration of the value a piece is held at and the issue of the credit. Each
task's tree has exactly the two prerequisite problems its draw calls for, each task's gold calls one owner=user task
tool, and no problem of either tree rests on an event outside the consultation. The two worlds share no customer, no
registration and no programme — task 0 runs on the Bridal Upgrade Guarantee and task 1 on the Lifetime Diamond
Upgrade Guarantee — so the published documents are exercised on two genuinely different settings of the same
charter.

REWORK ROUND 2 (source-layer audit, audits/policy_task/trade_up_desk). F-6: the credit-issue policy's baseline now
retains the fall-through sentence "The credit rests on the price the piece originally sold for", so the computation
document alone gives min(round(14500.00 x 70 / 100, 2), 14500.00) = 10150.00, the same figure as the recorded
baseline_result; the factor deciding the figure the credit rests on was rebuilt as a genuine method ladder — the
highest valuation the entries carry where the register holds a report inside the validity window, the lower of that
valuation and the original price where it holds none, the original price where the entries carry no valuation — three
methods that differ in what they read, with the tier taken on this world resting on the 21725.28 entry and report
AP-884570 (four days old); gold stays 19041.49 and every sensitivity figure is unchanged. F-5: credit_ceiling_held_to is
now declared a parameter, its tiers written as values. F-4: upkeep_treatment is now declared a parameter, its tiers
written as the multipliers they are; the valuation policy carries five parameter factors and one method factor. O-3:
the credit-issue rule no longer opens with a sentence restating both dependencies together. O-6 (1.md item 4): the
valuation policy now states that the piece is valued as a whole, stone and mounting together, as the appraisal
register values it, and declares that sentence as an override of base's stone-only clause. 1.md item 5: the issue
tool now writes the appraised value the credit rests on onto the registration, passed as its own argument
(21725.28, copied from the valuation entry), so the registration and its entries agree after the write. O-1: the tool
docstrings no longer carry "before calling" or "before handing this over". O-7: ceiling_recent is 45000.00
(forty-five thousand), so no programme's custody cap coincides with a tier; this customer sits on the custody-cap
tier and no figure moves. O-2 rests on frozen base sentences that ground no edge and is left as recorded. Gates were
re-run after the change and are recorded in the final report.
user_scenario:
You are Priya Raghunathan, fifty-two, a hospital pharmacist in Charlotte, brisk on the telephone and used to being the person who chases paperwork rather than the person who waits for it. Three weeks ago you left your platinum solitaire — the ring from your first engagement, which you have not worn in years — at the Queens Road branch of Belrose Fine Jewelers to be traded in under the lifetime upgrade guarantee, and on Thursday the appraiser's report finally arrived in your inbox. You have rung the upgrade desk on your lunch break to get the credit actually put in place, because you would like to start looking at a replacement at the weekend and you are not going to do that on a promise. That is the whole of what you want out of this call: the credit on your trade-in settled today rather than left sitting, and you are happy for the desk to do whatever it needs to do at its end to get there.

You start by saying what the call is about and giving your mobile number, 7045553584, since that is always the first thing asked. If you are asked to confirm who you are, you give your date of birth, 1974-02-26, and then the postal code of your billing address, 28209; you also know the email address the store has for you and can give it if those two will not do. You have no idea what reference number the trade-in carries — the paperwork is at home in a drawer — so that has to come from their side, and you say as much. If you are asked about the ring, you say you bought it at Queens Road in the autumn of 2014, that it has always been on the protection plan and went in for its check-up a few weeks before you handed it over, and that its laboratory paper is in the same drawer as everything else. If anyone asks what condition it is in, you say it looked perfect to you, but you add that you are not the one who grades rings.

You do not fill silences and you do not speculate. When the representative says that something has to be recorded or worked out at their end before the credit can be settled, you say that is fine and let them get on with it; you do not ask what it is or offer an opinion about how it should be done. If the representative reads you a figure, you write it down and say thank you; you have nothing to measure it against and you say so if you are asked whether it sounds right. When the representative tells you there is a step only you can take and unlocks it for you, you run it yourself without fuss, since it is your ring and your word that is being put on the record, and you read out whatever comes back if you are asked to. Once you hear that the credit is in place on your trade-in, you say that is what you rang for, thank them and ring off.

seed_consistency.check: The registration runs under the Lifetime Diamond Upgrade Guarantee, whose entry gate asks a minimum original price of 2999.00, a purchase from the chain and inspections kept current: the ring sold for 14500.00 on receipt BR-2014-330918 on 2014-11-08, far beyond the programme's 365-day minimum holding period, and the coverage on the piece shows its last inspection logged on 2026-05-20. Its status, waiting on a valuation, agrees with its entries, which carry two inspections and no valuation and no credit; the appraised value, the credit issued, the credit available, the issue date and the appraisal reference are all still empty, as they are on a registration whose valuation has not been booked. The grade printed on the registration is the one taken at the counter on 2026-05-28 and has not been brought into line with the bench grade of the following day.

The closed standard trade-in is consistent on its own terms: the programme takes pieces the chain did not sell, so the receipt is empty and the original price zero; the credit of 256.00 is 40 percent of the 640.00 appraised value at the excellent grade, which carries no condition deduction; the credit available is zero against the single 256.00 spend booked, the status is redeemed and the closing date 2021-08-30 is the date of that spend. Nothing on it is live and it carries no obligation this call must discharge.

The counter inspection was logged on 2026-05-28, the day the piece was registered and while the registration stood open, which is when the charter admits an inspection; it moves no money, so its amount is zero, and the grade excellent it records is the grade printed on the registration.

The bench inspection was logged on 2026-05-29, the day after the piece was taken in and while the registration stood waiting on its valuation, which the charter admits; it moves no money, so its amount is zero, and the grade good it records is the later of the two grades on the registration's entries.

The credit of 256.00 on the closed standard trade-in was booked on 2021-07-19, the issue date that registration carries, on the current market appraisal basis that programme values on, and equals the credit it shows as issued.

The spend of 256.00 on the closed standard trade-in was booked on 2021-08-30 against till transaction BR-2021-660417, took the whole of that credit at once as a programme that does not allow partial spending requires, and closed the registration on the same date.

evaluation_criteria.objective: Select the customer profile behind the caller from the mobile number she gives, and read back the details the identity check is measured against.
evaluation_criteria.necessity: Every record this call turns on — the trade-in registration, its entries, the appraisal, the coverage and the membership — is reached through this profile's reference number.

evaluation_criteria.objective: Measure the date of birth and the billing postal code the caller states against the profile on file and record the outcome.
evaluation_criteria.necessity: Identity must be cleared before anything of this customer's is read for money or written, and two agreeing details is what the check requires.

evaluation_criteria.objective: Read the trade-in registrations this customer holds: the live one waiting on its valuation, with its programme, the piece it covers, the price and date it originally sold at, its certificate, the stone's weight, the grade printed on it and the empty credit, issue date and appraisal reference, alongside the closed standard trade-in from 2021.
evaluation_criteria.necessity: The programme fixes every published figure the three writes use; the piece's original price and date, its certificate and its stone weight are read straight off this record, and the closed 2021 registration is excluded because it is redeemed and carries nothing.

evaluation_criteria.objective: Read every trade-in entry booked for this customer: the two condition inspections on the live registration with the grade each recorded and the date each was logged, and the two entries of the closed registration.
evaluation_criteria.necessity: The grade the valuation is reduced by is the one the later inspection entry records, and whether any valuation of the piece has been booked at all decides what the credit can rest on; the closed registration's entries belong to a different registration and are excluded.

evaluation_criteria.objective: Read the requests standing with the upgrade desk for this customer, and in particular whether any of them carries a declaration of the value the piece was taken in at that the customer has confirmed.
evaluation_criteria.necessity: The request taken when the piece was handed in stands recorded and unconfirmed, which is how the agent sees that the customer's own declaration is still missing and what the credit's ceiling would otherwise fall back to.

evaluation_criteria.objective: Read the appraisal engagements on the traded piece: the insurance replacement report issued four days ago with the value it states, the value it declares the piece at, the laboratory it names and its reference, and the fair market report from 2019.
evaluation_criteria.necessity: Whether a report stands inside the programme's validity window, the value it declares, and whether it names a laboratory decide what the valuation rests on, the weight addition and the certificate deduction; the 2019 report expired in 2020 and cannot carry them.

evaluation_criteria.objective: Read the entries on those engagements: the valuation recorded for the piece on each report, the fee charged on the current engagement and the payment taken against it.
evaluation_criteria.necessity: The highest value the register carries for the piece is what the valuation rests on, and what has actually been paid on the appraisal decides how much of the appraisal fee is added to the credit.

evaluation_criteria.objective: Read the coverage the customer holds on the traded piece: whether the plan is in force, the date of the last inspection logged against it and how many claims have been settled on it.
evaluation_criteria.necessity: Whether the piece is covered and how recently it was inspected decide the upkeep treatment of the valuation and the ceiling the declaration is held to, and a cover with no settled claim decides the addition made to the credit.

evaluation_criteria.objective: Read the entries on that coverage: the premium paid in full at the outset and the inspections logged against the piece.
evaluation_criteria.necessity: The inspection entries confirm the date the plan's own record gives for the last inspection, which is what the upkeep treatment of the valuation turns on.

evaluation_criteria.objective: Read the membership record: the tier held, whether a concierge is named on it, and the qualifying spend recorded over the life of the membership.
evaluation_criteria.necessity: The tier decides the share the credit is taken at, and the tier together with whether a concierge is named decides the addition made to the declared value.

evaluation_criteria.objective: Read the points entries on that membership, with the spend and the kind of sale each rests on.
evaluation_criteria.necessity: They show the membership is live and earning, and that the only spend recorded this quarter is the appraisal fee rather than a merchandise sale, so nothing in the loyalty history bears on the figures here.

argument_uniqueness_tracing.credit_reference: TU-620185 — the reference of the registration the ring was taken in on, read from the registration lookup at step 2; it is the only registration of this customer that is not closed, the other, TU-407712, having been redeemed in 2021.
argument_uniqueness_tracing.valuation_amount: 21725.28. The appraisal register carries 21400.00 for RING-48226 on report AP-884570, issued 2026-06-11, four days before the handling date and inside the programme's 365-day validity window, and that figure stands above the 14500.00 the ring originally sold for, so the valuation rests on it rather than on the original price. The later of the two inspection entries, on 2026-05-29, grades the piece good, so six percent comes off: 21400.00 x 94 / 100 = 20116.00. The registration carries the certificate GIA-5502841937 and AP-884570 names the laboratory GIA, so nothing comes off for the papers. The principal stone weighs 1.71 carats and that report declares the piece at 21400.00, which is twenty thousand or more, so eight percent is added: 20116.00 x 108 / 100 = 21725.28. The ring is covered by a plan in force whose last inspection was logged on 2026-05-20, inside twelve months, so the figure stands as worked out. The chain sold the piece on BR-2014-330918 and the customer has held it since 2014-11-08, far beyond five years, so the valuation is held to the 150000.00 the programme answers for in its care, which does not bite.
argument_uniqueness_tracing.appraiser_code: APR-233 — the appraiser who arrived at the figure. Read from the appraisal engagement at step 5: AP-884570, the report issued four days ago on this piece, carries APR-233; the 2019 engagement carries APR-160 and its report expired on 2020-03-11. The tool's schema fixes the form as APR- followed by three digits.
argument_uniqueness_tracing.valuation_basis: current_market_appraisal — the basis the figure was struck on. The valuation rests on the value the appraisal register carries for the piece today rather than on the price it originally sold for, which is what that value is: what the piece would fetch now, as an appraisal of its market value states. original_purchase_price does not hold, because the figure is not the 14500.00 the ring sold for in 2014; certified_lab_value does not hold, because no laboratory grading report states a value here, only an appraiser's report that names the laboratory; published_scrap_rate does not hold, because the piece is valued as jewellery and not for its metal; not_applicable does not hold, because this entry values the piece.

argument_uniqueness_tracing.credit_reference: TU-620185 — the registration her ring was taken in on, read from the registration lookup at step 2 and handed to her with the step; the closed registration TU-407712 holds no piece of hers.
argument_uniqueness_tracing.declared_custody_value: 24952.40. evaluation_criteria.objective: Issue 19041.49 USD of upgrade credit on registration TU-620185: the registration moves from waiting on its valuation to credit issued, the appraised value the credit rests on is written onto the registration, the whole of that credit is made available to spend, the issue is dated today and the credit is booked as an entry in the registration's history.

argument_uniqueness_tracing.credit_reference: TU-620185 — the registration the credit is issued on, read from the registration lookup at step 2; it is the only one standing at waiting on a valuation.
argument_uniqueness_tracing.issued_credit_amount: 19041.49. The registration's entries now carry a valuation of the piece, 21725.28, and the appraisal register carries report AP-884570 on the piece issued 2026-06-11, inside the 365-day validity window, so the credit rests on the highest valuation the entries carry, 21725.28. Her membership stands at Belrose Circle Platinum, above Belrose Circle Gold, and she has held the ring since 2014-11-08, more than ten years, so the share is eighty-five percent rather than the seventy percent the programme publishes for a current appraised value: 21725.28 x 85 / 100 = 18466.49. The programme credits its appraisal fee against the upgrade and the payment of 175.00 taken on 2026-05-29 covers the 175.00 fee in full, so 175.00 is added. The ring is covered by a plan in force with no claim settled on it, so 400.00 is added. The value she declared the piece at, 24952.40, stands confirmed on the request record and is below the programme's 74999.00 largest credit, so the credit is held to 24952.40, which does not bite: 18466.49 + 175.00 + 400.00 = 19041.49.
argument_uniqueness_tracing.appraised_value: 21725.28 — the value the piece was appraised at for this credit, copied from the valuation entry recorded against the registration at step 12 (its receipt and the registration's entry history both carry 21725.28); it is the one valuation entry the registration carries, so no other figure can be the appraised value the credit was issued on.

edges.condition: The registration's entries carry the appraiser's valuation of the traded piece.
edges.policy_source: The credit issued is fixed only after the registration's entries carry the appraiser's valuation of the traded piece.

unresolved_at_frozen_time.why_false: The registration's entries carry two condition inspections and nothing else: no valuation of the piece has ever been booked to it, and the registration's own appraised value is still zero, although a report on the piece was issued on 2026-06-11. With no valuation among the entries the credit would rest on the 14500.00 the ring originally sold for.
unresolved_at_frozen_time.flips_to_true_by: The write of the valuation problem books a valuation entry of 21725.28 to the registration, so the entries carry one valuation and the credit rests on it instead of on the original price.

edges.condition: The upgrade desk's request record for the registration carries a declaration of the value the piece was taken in at that the customer has confirmed.
edges.policy_source: The credit is issued only once the upgrade desk's request record carries the customer's own confirmed declaration of the value the piece was taken in at.

unresolved_at_frozen_time.why_false: The only request standing on this registration was taken when the piece was handed in on 2026-05-28 and still reads as recorded rather than confirmed by the customer, and it carries no amount at all. With no confirmed declaration the credit would be held to the 14500.00 the ring originally sold for.
unresolved_at_frozen_time.flips_to_true_by: The write of the declaration problem takes a request record confirmed by the customer carrying 24952.40, so the ceiling the credit is held to becomes that declared value.

prerequisite_closure.order_uniqueness: The two prerequisites of the credit issue may be taken in either order and the terminal state is the same. The valuation write adds one entry to the registration's entries and touches nothing else; the declaration write takes a new request record and writes the appraisal reference onto the registration, and touches neither the entries nor any figure the valuation reads. Neither computation reads what the other writes: the valuation rests on the appraisal register, the registration's inspection entries, the coverage and the piece's own fields, while the declaration rests on the appraisal register, the membership and the coverage. Recomputed both ways the figures are identical — the declaration comes to 24952.40 whether it is taken before or after the valuation, and the valuation comes to 21725.28 either way — and the rows each write lands are distinct, so the terminal database is the same in both orders.

edge_load_bearing.skipped_effect: Skipping the valuation write and replaying the rest leaves the registration's entries carrying no valuation, so the credit rests on the 14500.00 original price and the credit issued recomputes to 12900.00 instead of 19041.49; the terminal registration also carries no valuation entry.

Skipping the declaration write and replaying the rest leaves no confirmed declaration on the request record, so the ceiling falls back to the 14500.00 original price and the credit issued recomputes to 14500.00 instead of 19041.49; the terminal records also carry no confirmed request and no appraisal reference on the registration.

prerequisite_closure.no_user_hint: user_scenario names neither prerequisite problem and neither of their figures. The customer asks only that the credit on her trade-in be settled today; she never mentions a valuation entry, a declaration, a request record or anything that has to be put right first, and her one general line about them is that when the representative says something has to be recorded or worked out at their end she says that is fine and lets them get on with it. She does not ask what it is, and she offers no opinion about how it should be done, so an agent that misses either prerequisite hears exactly what an agent that finds them hears.
prerequisite_closure.tools_do_not_block: None of the three tools validates a prerequisite. issue_upgrade_credit_f63e5226 looks the registration up by its reference and writes the credit it is given, whether or not any valuation stands among the entries and whether or not a confirmed declaration stands on the request record; log_item_valuation_6ae79dd2 books the figure it is given without reading the request record; confirm_custody_declaration_bb764f94 takes the declaration without reading the entries. Missing a prerequisite therefore raises no error and produces no hint: it produces a different terminal hash, because a row is missing and the credit written differs.
